commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+7' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball has crossed the sideline. Atl. Madrid are taking a throw-in.
90+4' What a great touch by Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom right corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
90+3' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Atl. Madrid.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' Abner (Betis) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
88' The corner from Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) is intercepted by the defence.

87' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Atl. Madrid will take a corner kick.
86' The resulting corner from Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) is cleared.
85' Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The linesman points to the corner flag, Atl. Madrid are going to take it.
84' Substitution. Ayoze Perez makes his way off the pitch and Andres Guardado (Betis) comes on as his replacement.
84' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) creates himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot which is blocked by a defender.
82' Rodri (Betis) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
80' A crossfield pass from Saul Niguez (Atl. Madrid) fails to find any of his teammates.
80' Rodrigo de Paul will be replaced by Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid).
79' An attempted cross from Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) is cleared.

70' Ayoze Perez (Betis) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. Betis will have a throw-in.
67' Betis control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
65' The resulting set piece from Atl. Madrid is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
65' Substitution. Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) replaces Yannick Carrasco.
65' Atl. Madrid failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. Atl. Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
64' We are about to witness a subsitution. Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) for Thomas Lemar.
64' Diego Simeone has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Saul Niguez (Atl. Madrid) replacing Memphis Depay.
62' Borja Iglesias goes off the pitch and Willian Jose (Betis) comes on.
61' Yannick Carrasco (Atl. Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
59' Thomas Lemar (Atl. Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
58' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Atl. Madrid.
56' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Marc Roca (Betis). Atl. Madrid will take a free kick near the side line.
55' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Atl. Madrid comes to nothing.
54' Referee Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Diego Simeone, then shows him a yellow.
52' Stefan Savic (Atl. Madrid) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
51' Isco (Betis) receives a yellow card for infringement.
51' The Atl. Madrid players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
50' Atl. Madrid take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
47' Thomas Lemar (Atl. Madrid) meets a cross just outside the area and gets in a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
46' Half-time substitution. Diego Simeone decided to make a change. Marcos Llorente is replaced by Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+6' The end of the first half.
45+4' Isco (Betis) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he misses the left post by a whisker. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.

45+2' Great ball in from Isco. Aitor Ruibal (Betis) should really have done better with a close-range header, but he heads it a whisker over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
45+2' Neat passing move from Betis in order to create new attacking opportunities.
45+1' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
43' The game has begun to heat up. Stefan Savic (Atl. Madrid) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
43' Stefan Savic (Atl. Madrid) trips an opposition player and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea signals a foul. Betis will take a free kick.
41' The corner is swung in but Atl. Madrid can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
41' Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The referee blows his whistle, Atl. Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
38' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.

37' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea who sees an offensive foul. Atl. Madrid have been awarded a free kick.

34' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) receives a lofted pass from the flank and shoots from close range, but the ball flies slightly wide, almost brushing the right-hand post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
31' The referee blows for a cooling break.
30' Borja Iglesias (Betis) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
29' Betis seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
27' Yannick Carrasco (Atl. Madrid) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
25' Atl. Madrid are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
24' Youssouf Sabaly (Betis) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.

22' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Ayoze Perez (Betis), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
20' Isco (Betis) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
20' The Betis players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
16' Yannick Carrasco (Atl. Madrid) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Rui Silva, who smothers the ball.
15' The ball is cleared after Yannick Carrasco (Atl. Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
15' The corner from Isco (Betis) is intercepted by Jan Oblak.
14' Ayoze Perez (Betis) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. Betis have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
12' Flag up against Borja Iglesias (Betis). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
11' Yannick Carrasco (Atl. Madrid) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball is out of play. Betis will take a throw-in.
10' Great teamplay by Betis as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
9' Isco (Betis) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
8' Abner (Betis) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball goes behind for a corner. Betis will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
7' Borja Iglesias (Betis) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. It's a throw-in for Atl. Madrid.
6' The free kick is taken short by Betis.
6' Mario Hermoso (Atl. Madrid) tackles a bit over-zealously and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows for a foul. A free kick to Betis.
4' Betis enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

2' Nice move, nice attempt! Abner (Betis) is teed up with a simple pass after a nice flowing move. His first time shot from mid-range looks like it's going in but curls just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
2' Yannick Carrasco (Atl. Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The linesman signals a throw-in for Atl. Madrid.
